segment: Fleet enablers and economics: what a credible fleet offer from a small e-moto / e-bike OEM looks like in 2026
summary: No third-party lessor was found that will finance 10-50 units of a young OEM's e-motos or e-bikes on the OEM's paper. The realistic path is: (1) Clicklease-style point-of-sale lease-to-own for small tickets ($500-$20k per approval, 24-60 months, all FICO, soft pull, but effective cost is very high - customers report paying more than double), which covers 3-8 INNO or 2-4 FLASH per business; (2) HMP self-funded Mode C leases for anything larger, capped by HMP's own capital; (3) a real lessor only after 12 months of loss data. Zoomo, the benchmark, funds its own fleet with $30M venture debt (Viola) and sells businesses Buy / Service / Lease packages with no public price list. Telematics: Monimoto 9 ($179 + $49/yr) and Trackimo 4G ($139-239 + $60/yr) are consumer trackers without immobilization; shared-mobility IoT modules run $45-120 per unit in quantity plus $2-5/month connectivity (Levy: $50-150 IoT per bike, software $0 revenue-share to $500/mo). Insurance: small e-bike rental fleets pay $1,200-3,100/yr (about $5-26 per bike-month) for property cover; commercial delivery liability is priced by specialist brokers only; e-motorcycle rental/delivery fleets are a surplus-lines risk (XInsurance-type) with no public rate - assume $40-100 per unit-month. OEM benchmarks: Zero and LiveWire publish no fleet program; Zero clears inventory with up to $5,000 off and 2.99% APR/48 months, so 'fleet discount' in this market means 10-25% plus subvented financing. Cake (bankrupt Feb 2024 after two recalls) and Ubco (receivership Jan 2025 five months after a 175-bike Australia Post deal) are the objections every fleet buyer will raise: solvency, recall exposure and parts continuity. fleet_econ.py holds up on INNO/FLASH landed costs but understates e-moto insurance, warranty reserve and the customer's financing cost; Mode B FLASH at 25 units ($5,100, $1,866 contribution) is the only line with fleet-grade margin.

key_facts.claim: Clicklease: financing $500 minimum to $20,000 maximum (marketing says approvals up to $25,000), 24-60 month terms, lease-to-own with either market-value or low fixed buyout, all FICO scores may apply, soft credit pull, no stated time-in-business minimum, early-payoff discount up to 5%; rates undisclosed; reviews cite 'paying more than double the amount borrowed', hidden fees, slow approvals; vendors enroll and can embed white-label financing on their website

Zoomo business offer: BUY ('purchase your Zoomo vehicle outright, add software optionally at a monthly fee'), SERVICE (service an existing fleet, software optional), LEASE ('full Zoomo platform solution of hardware, servicing and software at a monthly fee'); packages tailored, no prices published; Zoomo raised a $30M Series B plus a $30M debt facility from Viola Group
Monimoto 9 motorcycle GPS tracker: $179 device, $49/year subscription (about $4.08/month); battery-powered, alerts via app; no immobilizer
Trackimo 4G tracker: $238.99 list ($138.90 discounted) with 1-year data plan included; $60/year renewal; no immobilizer

Shared-micromobility IoT/GPS modules cost 60-120 USD per device (no monthly fees, model/quantity dependent) or 45-85 USD per piece with some makers charging monthly connectivity; Teltonika FTC305 is a 4G LTE Cat 1 e-mobility tracker with CAN bus reading; Comodule (Tallinn) supplies Bolt/Jump-class operators

Levy Fleets e-bike rental playbook (10-bike launch): fleet-grade e-bike $1,500-3,000; IoT hardware $50-150 per bike; software $0 upfront on revenue-share up to $500/mo; insurance $500-3,000/yr; total launch $16,000-40,000; hourly rental $8-15

Bike-rental insurance: a 15-25 bike fleet typically pays $1,200-3,100/yr for full coverage; dedicated e-bike policies $100-300/yr; cargo/commercial use priced separately; 'work with a broker who has placed bike-fleet risk before' and bring storage, lock and tracker documentation to the quote

Personal California motorcycle insurance starts around $50/yr (Voom pay-per-mile) and $75/yr (Progressive, covers 50cc+ scooters); these are personal policies and exclude business/rental use; XInsurance writes custom motorcycle-rental and e-bike-rental business coverage (specialty market, no published rate)

Zero Motorcycles 'Go Electric': up to $5,000 off MY2023-2025 bikes through 30 Jun 2026, stackable with financing, demo ride ($500 rebate, all 2026), military/first-responder and loyalty programs; X-Line 'Charge Into Spring' 2.99% APR, $0 down, up to 48 months (1 May-30 Jun 2026). No published fleet or authority price list
LiveWire S2 Del Mar $11,999, S2 Mulholland $11,999, S2 Alpinista $12,999 (June 2026); LiveWire clearing 2021-22 One inventory at $16,499; Zero pushed into sub-$7,000 bikes in 2025

Cake filed for bankruptcy 2 Feb 2024 after a Makka steering-column recall, a Kalk fire in a South Korean dealership, and investors pulling out before a funding round; CEO: 'not one but several circumstances'; brand later revived under new ownership
UBCO entered receivership in January 2025, five months after announcing a 175-motorcycle Australia Post deployment; the company ran out of cash
Broader micromobility failures cited alongside Cake: Superpedestrian shut down, Bird bankruptcy, Micromobility.com delisted, Tier-Dott merger
HMP internal: FLASH landed ~$2,800 to LA; INNO ASP $2,300; SF INNO rental $390/mo; Whizz SF $169/mo rent-to-own with $99 buyout after 12 payments (from fleet_context.md and fleet_econ.py)

financing_partners.name: Clicklease (vendor point-of-sale lease-to-own)
financing_partners.what: Small-ticket equipment lease; vendor enrolls, customer applies online; approvals $500-$20k (up to $25k marketed), 24-60 months, all FICO, soft pull
financing_partners.terms: Rates undisclosed; effective cost per reviews can exceed 2x principal over term; buyout options (market value or low fixed); early payoff discount up to 5%; sales tax and fees added
financing_partners.fit_for_hmp: Good for 1-8 unit orders from small operators (ghost kitchens, courier crews, rental shops) who cannot pass bank credit; enables HMP to be paid cash at delivery. Not a fleet lessor: a 25-FLASH order ($127k) is far above the cap and must be split per business

financing_partners.name: Zoomo (competitor benchmark, not a partner)
financing_partners.what: OEM-operator that leases e-bikes to businesses with servicing and software; funds fleet with $30M venture debt (Viola) + $30M Series B
financing_partners.terms: Buy / Service / Lease packages; no public prices; lease is 'hardware, servicing and software at a monthly fee'
financing_partners.fit_for_hmp: Shows the market expects the OEM to carry the asset risk and bundle service; HMP Mode C ($151-238/unit-month) competes here only if HMP can fund ~$1.4-2.9k per unit

financing_partners.name: Mitsubishi HC Capital America (vendor finance programs)
financing_partners.what: Independent equipment lender that runs vendor programs, trade-in and remarketing support
financing_partners.terms: Not published; targets established OEMs and dealers with volume and resale data
financing_partners.fit_for_hmp: Unlikely before HMP has 12+ months of residual and loss data; ASSUMPTION

financing_partners.name: OEM-subvented bank financing (Zero model)
financing_partners.what: Zero offers 2.99% APR / $0 down / 48 months via partner lenders, stacked with up to $5,000 rebates
financing_partners.terms: Consumer retail; requires OEM buy-down of rate
financing_partners.fit_for_hmp: HMP cannot subvent at $2,000-2,300 contribution per FLASH; use price, not rate, as the lever

financing_partners.name: HMP self-funded lease (Mode C)
financing_partners.what: 24-month lease at $151 (INNO) / $185 (MK.II) / $238 (FLASH) per month from fleet_econ.py
financing_partners.terms: Capital tied up $1,390 / $1,990 / $2,890 per unit; 25% residual assumed; 14% cost of capital
financing_partners.fit_for_hmp: Only viable for a handful of anchor fleets (e.g. 20-40 units = $60-120k capital); contribution $39-62/unit-month is thin against theft and bad debt

telematics_vendors.name: Monimoto 9
telematics_vendors.features: Battery-powered GPS/LTE anti-theft tracker, phone-call alarm, app; no remote immobilizer; consumer-grade, easy to hide on INNO/MK.II/FLASH

telematics_vendors.name: Trackimo 4G
telematics_vendors.features: 4G GPS tracker, magnetic/hard-wire kit $39.95, worldwide SIM; no immobilizer

telematics_vendors.name: Teltonika FTC305 / shared-mobility IoT modules (Teltonika, Comodule, Chinese 4G OEM modules)
telematics_vendors.monthly_cost: $2-5 connectivity (ESTIMATE) + platform $0 (revenue share) to $500/mo per fleet (Levy)
telematics_vendors.features: Wired 4G LTE Cat 1 tracker with CAN bus reading, remote lock/unlock/immobilize via relay, battery SOC, geofence; used by Bolt/Jump-class operators; needs a platform (Atom Mobility, GPSWOX or OEM cloud)

telematics_vendors.name: Invers CloudBoxx
telematics_vendors.features: Fleet-sharing telematics for mopeds/cars; enterprise quote only

insurance.case: INNO e-bike rental / delivery fleet (Class 2, no registration)
insurance.carrier_or_broker: Specialist bike-fleet brokers (insuremy.bike commercial program; Velosurance/Sundays are consumer); Levy quotes $500-3,000/yr for a 10-bike launch
insurance.premium_range: $5-26 per bike-month for property/theft on a 15-25 bike fleet; commercial general liability for delivery use is extra and quoted case-by-case (ESTIMATE $15-40 per bike-month all-in for delivery)
insurance.exclusions: Personal e-bike policies exclude business/delivery use; theft cover conditional on documented storage, locks and trackers; cargo bikes priced separately

insurance.case: FLASH / MK.II commercial fleet (registered motorcycles, M1 riders, rental or delivery use)
insurance.carrier_or_broker: Surplus-lines specialists (XInsurance motorcycle-rental / e-bike-rental business program); Progressive Commercial and Voom write personal or small-business motorcycle policies that exclude rental fleets
insurance.premium_range: Personal CA motorcycle from $50-75/yr; commercial rental/delivery fleet not published - ESTIMATE $500-1,200 per bike-year ($40-100 per unit-month) for liability + physical damage with high deductibles
insurance.exclusions: Personal policies exclude delivery and rental; platform (DoorDash/Uber) occupational cover does not cover the vehicle; renter license verification required (CVC 14608/14609); garagekeepers needed if HMP stores customer bikes

insurance.carrier_or_broker: Levy Fleets (bundles maintenance, insurance and replacement)
insurance.premium_range: $149 per bike per month all-in (from earlier search summary of Levy)

oem_fleet_benchmarks.program: No public fleet/authority program; consumer 'Go Electric' promo + demo-ride rebate + military/first-responder + loyalty programs
oem_fleet_benchmarks.discount: Up to $5,000 off MY2023-25 (roughly 30-40% on $12-16k bikes) + $500 demo rebate; 2.99% APR/48 mo on X-Line
oem_fleet_benchmarks.sla: dealer network service; none published for fleets
oem_fleet_benchmarks.outcome: Market leader clears inventory with deep discounts and subvented rates; sets buyer expectations that an e-moto fleet deal includes 20%+ off and cheap financing
Premium pricing; not a fleet competitor to FLASH at $4,800-5,400

oem_fleet_benchmarks.program: No fleet program surfaced in searches

oem_fleet_benchmarks.outcome: Bankrupt 2 Feb 2024: two recalls (steering column; battery fire) + investor withdrawal; revived under new owner. Lesson: recall exposure and funding dependence kill an OEM faster than demand

oem_fleet_benchmarks.program: Utility 2x2 fleet bikes and subscriptions; 175-bike Australia Post deal (Aug 2024)
oem_fleet_benchmarks.outcome: Receivership Jan 2025; ran out of cash despite a marquee fleet order. Lesson: fleet orders are slow-paying and service-heavy; do not fund growth on them

oem_fleet_benchmarks.program: Buy / Service / Lease for business fleets
oem_fleet_benchmarks.sla: servicing and software included in Lease
oem_fleet_benchmarks.outcome: Still operating on venture debt; the benchmark HMP is measured against

unit_economics_benchmarks.value: $4-5/month consumer trackers; $2-5 connectivity + platform for fleet modules
$149 per bike-month (Levy) vs HMP Mode C INNO lease $151
Whizz $169/mo, $99 buyout after 12 payments; HMP SF $390/mo

unit_economics_benchmarks.item: Small-ticket lease cost to the customer
unit_economics_benchmarks.value: Clicklease: reviews report total payments >2x principal over 24-60 months (implied 35-60% effective APR)

fleet_econ_critique.reason: A fleet needs a wired 4G module with immobilizer relay ($45-120 in quantity) plus install labor; Monimoto-class battery trackers ($179) cannot immobilize. $110 blended incl. install

Consumer trackers are $4-5/month; fleet connectivity $2-5/month; $12 only if HMP pays for a fleet-management SaaS seat per bike. Keep 12 for Mode A (HMP-operated), use 6 for Mode B/C where the buyer runs the platform

E-bike fleet property cover is $5-26 per bike-month, so $10 is low for delivery use; motorcycles in commercial rental/delivery use are a surplus-lines risk with no public rate - $10 is not credible. Model currently applies one number to all three products

Cake's two recalls in three months preceded its bankruptcy; a young OEM offering a 24-month delivery-duty warranty with no field data should reserve 6% until 100 fleet units have 12 months of claims history

Fine for HMP's own revolver, but add a separate customer-side rate: Clicklease-type leases imply 35-60% effective; Mode C lease at 1.35x carrying cost ($151 INNO) is cheaper than what small operators can get elsewhere, which is why they will prefer HMP paper and why HMP must gate it with deposits
Zero's up to $5,000 off (30-40%) shows buyers expect deep discounts on e-motos, but FLASH at $4,800 is already 30% under Zero's cheapest; hold 20% and compete on price level, not percent
Consistent with fleet-grade e-bike cost band ($1,500-3,000 retail to operators); INNO's cost advantage is real if quality holds

Levy all-in operator subscription is $149 and Whizz rider rent-to-own $169; a $220 LA rider price needs a service/battery bundle to justify; Mode A at $220 already yields only $12/unit-month, so Mode A should not be the LA lead offer

No LA-specific fleet theft data found this session; insurers explicitly price on storage/locks/tracker policy, so the model should make theft a function of telematics + indoor storage rather than a flat 8%

inno.warranty: 24 months / unlimited miles on frame, motor, controller; battery 24 months to 70% capacity; wear items excluded; delivery duty explicitly covered
inno.telematics: Optional wired 4G tracker with immobilizer at $110 + $6/month, or customer-supplied Monimoto; UL 2849 certificate and 330 lb load rating sheet supplied with every unit
inno.sla: Loaner within 2 business days for warranty failures within 15 miles of 768 Ceres Ave; 48-hour parts pick-up; quarterly fleet inspection for 25+ units
inno.deposit_terms: Purchase: 30% at order, balance before release; Clicklease available per business up to $20k (about 8 units); Lease: 2 months payment as deposit, 24-month term, $460 buyout (25% of landed) at end
inno.hmp_contribution_per_unit: $457 / $347 / $236 at 10 / 25 / 50 units (Mode B); $39 per unit-month on lease
inno.notes: Thin margin below 25 units; lead with battery subscription ($50/mo) and SANS charger sales to lift contribution; do not sell into grant programs without UL 2849

mk2.warranty: 24 months / 20,000 miles powertrain; battery 24 months to 70%; delivery/rental use covered with monthly inspection log
mk2.telematics: Factory 4G module with immobilizer included at 25+ units ($110 cost absorbed); $6/month connectivity billed to fleet
mk2.sla: Mobile tech within 3 business days in LA County; loaner at 25+ units; parts stocked at Ceres Ave for 5% of fleet
mk2.deposit_terms: 30% at order; balance before DMV registration; buyer must show commercial motorcycle policy and M1 rider roster; lease: 2 months deposit, 24 months, $475 buyout
mk2.hmp_contribution_per_unit: $1,325 / $1,133 / $941 at 10 / 25 / 50 units; $48 per unit-month on lease
mk2.notes: Requires HMP CA DMV dealer license to sell; insurance ($40-100/unit-month) is the buyer's largest recurring cost and must be pre-arranged with a surplus-lines broker before quoting

flash.warranty: 24 months / 20,000 miles powertrain; battery 24 months to 70%; second battery pack on Dual at 20% fleet discount
flash.telematics: Factory 4G module with immobilizer included at 10+ units; $6/month connectivity
flash.sla: Mobile tech within 3 business days; loaner within 2 business days at 25+ units; 24-month parts-continuity letter and escrowed spare-parts kit (5% of fleet value) to answer the Cake/Ubco objection
flash.deposit_terms: 30% at order, balance before registration; lease: 2 months deposit, 24 months, $700 buyout; fleets over 25 units may stage delivery monthly to spread the buyer's insurance and registration cost
flash.hmp_contribution_per_unit: $2,154 / $1,866 / $1,578 at 10 / 25 / 50 units; $62 per unit-month on lease
flash.notes: Only product with fleet-grade margin; 268 units at 25-unit pricing = $500k contribution. Price FLASH at 30% under Zero's cheapest bike and let Zero's rebates set the reference

red_flags: No lessor will carry HMP-brand assets today; every fleet sale over ~$20k per customer is either cash or HMP's own balance sheet.
Clicklease-type financing is expensive enough (customers report >2x payback) that it can damage HMP's reputation with courier-community buyers; disclose cost clearly.
fleet_econ.py applies $10/unit-month insurance to motorcycles; commercial e-moto fleet insurance is unpriced in public sources and likely 4-10x that.
Fleet buyers will ask about OEM solvency (Cake, Ubco, Superpedestrian, Bird); HMP needs a parts-continuity commitment and escrowed spares to close.
Mode A (HMP-operated INNO rental) at LA pricing ($220) yields $12/unit-month; at Whizz-matched $169 it loses money; Mode A should not anchor the LA plan.
Telematics without immobilization (Monimoto) does not reduce theft loss enough for insurers; a wired module adds $110 and installation labor per unit.
Zero's up-to-$5,000 rebates and 2.99% financing through mid-2026 mean used/discounted Zeros compete with FLASH for small fleets on total cost.
